drivers.title: Monsoon and crop output
drivers.good_when: Rainfall is normal, sowing is up and crop prices hold, so farm incomes and input sales grow.
drivers.bad_when: Rainfall is deficient or uneven, sowing falls and low crop prices squeeze farmers' income.
drivers.current_view: Negative: ICRA (1 Oct 2026) puts 2026 monsoon rainfall at 87% of the long-period average, the lowest since 2015, and cut FY2027 agriculture GVA growth to about 1%.
drivers.source: ICRA report, 1 Oct 2026 (user-provided, verify the original)

drivers.title: Fertiliser subsidy and MSP policy
drivers.good_when: Timely subsidy payments, steady MSP hikes and stable import prices protect fertiliser company margins.
drivers.bad_when: Subsidy payments are delayed, import prices spike, or export and price controls cut margins.
